why: Options 1, 2, 3 and 5 are the same notched triangle, only turned to different positions. Option 4 is its mirror image (flipped over), so no amount of turning will make it match the others.
trick: Follow one feature, such as the notch, around the outline; in the flipped figure it is on the other side.
